comment: Corpus provenance registry (LEV-12). Single machine-readable source for canonical URLs, snapshots, licences, expected filenames, SHA-256 checksums and citations. Read by scripts/fetch_corpora.py, levy/dataset/validation.py and scripts/rehydrate_dataset.py -- do not restate these facts elsewhere. A null sha256 means 'not yet pinned': run `python scripts/fetch_corpora.py --pin` once, against the files you actually hold, and a later mismatch becomes a hard failure.

quora-qqp.title: Quora Question Pairs
quora-qqp.licence: Quora Terms of Service - non-commercial research use, no redistribution grant
quora-qqp.manual_reason: The hosting platform requires signing in and accepting the competition rules before the data can be downloaded. This repository does not handle credentials.
quora-qqp.citation: Iyer, S., Dandekar, N., & Csernai, K. (2017). First Quora Dataset Release: Question Pairs. Quora.
quora-qqp.notes: QuoraQQPSource reads a tab-separated file with the columns id, qid1, qid2, question1, question2, is_duplicate. The GLUE QQP export ships exactly that as train.tsv; the Kaggle release ships train.csv with the same columns comma-separated, which must be converted to TSV before use.

sodd.title: SODD - Stack Overflow Duplicity Dataset
sodd.snapshot: MQDD release; derived from the archive.org Stack Overflow dump of June 2020
sodd.manual_reason: Distributed as a Google Drive folder, which has no stable direct-download URL per file. Download the shards from the folder by hand into data/raw/sodd/.
sodd.citation: Pasek, J., Sido, J., Konopik, M., & Prazak, O. (2023). MQDD: Pre-training of Multimodal Question Duplicity Detection for Software Engineering Domain. In Proceedings of RANLP 2023.
sodd.notes: Gzipped parquet, one file per split, columns first_post, second_post, first_author, second_author, label, page. Label classes: 0=duplicates, 1=similar (fulltext search), 2=similar (tags), 3=different, 4=accepted answer. The author columns are usernames and are deliberately never read. Posts are HTML and are normalised by levy.dataset.normalize.

twitter-pit2015.title: Twitter Paraphrase Corpus (SemEval-2015 Task 1, PIT)
twitter-pit2015.snapshot: SemEval-2015 shared-task release, cocoxu/SemEval-PIT2015 master branch
twitter-pit2015.licence: SemEval-2015 Task 1 shared-task release, research use; see the repository for the organisers' terms
twitter-pit2015.citation: Xu, W., Callison-Burch, C., & Dolan, W. B. (2015). SemEval-2015 Task 1: Paraphrase and Semantic Similarity in Twitter (PIT). In Proceedings of SemEval-2015.
twitter-pit2015.notes: Tab-separated, seven columns: Topic_Id, Topic_Name, Sent_1, Sent_2, Label, Sent_1_tag, Sent_2_tag. Train and dev carry a 5-annotator vote count such as (4, 1); the test split instead carries a single expert 0-5 grade, so it is rejected rather than coerced onto the vote scale. Both files live inside the release zip, extracted by basename so the archive's internal layout is not encoded here.
